turns.content: yaar ajeeb sa scene ho gaya hai. Manav — mera school ka dost, chhe saal se saath reh rahe hain — woh shift ho raha hai, apni fiancée ke saath rahega. Baat theek hai, hona hi tha shaadi se pehle. Par mujhe yeh building ke WhatsApp group se pata chala. Owner ne pucha "flat mein naya banda kab aa raha hai?" Main wahin baitha tha. Mujhe usne bataya hi nahi tha ab tak.

Yaar, samajh raha hoon. Yeh waada waala hurt toh bilkul valid hai. Chhe saal ka dost, saath mein reh rahe ho, aur tujhe building ke WhatsApp group se pata chala? Woh bhi owner ke sawaal se? Matlab usne khud tujhe nahi bataya ab tak.

Yeh cheez toh pakka lagti hai ki usne tujhe avoid kiya. Shayad sharma raha tha, ya maybe usne socha ki baat karne mein uncomfortable hoga. Lekin chhe saal ki dosti ke baad, ek simple "bhai, main shift kar raha hoon" toh banta hi tha na.

Tujhe lag raha hai ki woh tujhse door ho raha hai? Ya yeh sirf yeh incident ka issue hai?Yaar, yeh genuinely hurt lagta hai. Chhe saal ka dost, saath reh rahe ho, aur tujhe pata hi nahi ki woh shift ho raha hai? Aur woh bhi building group se, owner ke message se? Matlab usne tujhe khud bataya hi nahi.

Sahi mein yeh thoda ajeeb aur dukh ho sakta hai. Woh shaadi ki taraf badh raha hai, theek hai — woh life move kar raha hai. Par tujhe batana toh banta tha na? Kam se kam "bhai, main shift kar raha hoon, baat karte hain" — yeh toh hona hi chahiye tha.

Tujhe lag raha hai ki woh intentionally chhup raha tha ya shayad awkward feel kar raha tha batane mein? Kuch aur baat hai kya dono ke beech?

phir raat ko usne casually bola "haan yaar batane hi wala tha, busy chal raha tha." Busy? Chhe saal ek kamre mein rahe hain, uski har cheez mujhe sabse pehle pata hoti thi. Uska rishta pakka hua toh main mithai leke uske ghar gaya tha. Aur ab main building group se pata karta hoon ki mera ghar khali ho raha hai.

Yaar, yeh "busy" waala excuse toh kaat deta hai. Chhe saal ek roof ke neeche, aur "busy"?

Tujhe hurt isliye ho raha hai kyunki tujhe laga ki tum dono ka bond aisa tha ki yeh sabse pehle tujhe pata hona chahiye. Aur woh reason nahi, feeling hai — ki main uske liye itna special nahi raha jaisa main sochta tha.

Usne mithai waale din pe tujhe zaroor bataya hoga, kyunki tab woh excited tha. Ab shift kar raha hai, toh shayad usko lag raha ki tujhe batane se tu udaas hoga ya kuch uncomfortable hoga. Lekin yeh galat approach hai — dost ko avoid karke protect karna nahi, honestly batana chahiye tha.

Tujhe ab usse baat karni chahiye? Ya ab thoda distance laga hai dil meinYaar, yeh "busy" sun ke aur bhi bura laga hoga. Tujhe mithai leke jaana yaad hai usko — par tujhe yeh baat batane ki fursat nahi mili?

Woh probably avoid kar raha tha kyunki uncomfortable feel kar raha hoga — ki "bhai chhe saal saath rahe, ab akela chhod ke ja raha hoon" bolna awkward lag raha hoga. Shayad usne socha ki baat karne mein tu sad ho jayega, ya woh khud guilty feel kar raha tha. Lekin galat tareeka hai. Dost se direct baat karni chahiye thi, WhatsApp group se nahi pata chalna chahiye.

Aur "busy" ka reason sun ke toh aur lagta hai ki usne proper reason nahi diya. Jaise lightly le liya. Chhe saal ki dosti "busy" se justify nahi hoti.

Tujhe ab lag raha hoga ki — yeh banda mujhe ab priority nahi rakh raha. Fiancé aayi, life badal gayi, aur main side mein reh gaya. Yeh feeling hai na, sach mein dukh hoti hai.

Kya tujhe usse baat karna chahiye ki "bhai, yeh theek nahi tha" — ya ab bas chup rehna sahi lagega?

It's fine. I have made my peace with it. People get married, people move on, priorities change. This is how life works. I will figure out the flat situation. It is not a big deal and I would prefer not to make it one.

I hear you. And honestly, that's a mature way to look at it. You're right — people move on, priorities shift, and that's just how life goes.

But yaar, even if you've made peace with it logically, it's also okay if it still stings a bit emotionally. You don't have to make it a big deal with him, but you also don't have to pretend it didn't hurt. Chhe saal ka bond tha — woh kuch toh cheez hoti hai.

And you will figure out the flat situation. You're clearly someone who handles things on your own, and that's strength. Just don't go full "sab theek hai, kisi zaroorat nahi" mode with yourself too, okay? Sometimes we're honest with everyone except ourselves.

If you ever want to vent, you know where to come. No judgment, no gyaan. Bas sun lunga.

soch raha hoon usko bas itna reply kar doon — "Congratulations. I will start looking for a new flatmate from next week." Simple, clean, no drama. Usko bhi clear ho jayega aur mujhe bhi baar baar explain nahi karna padega. Theek hai na yeh?

Theek hai, clean aur practical hai. But yaar — "Congratulations" aur "new flatmate" ek hi message mein? It's coming across a bit cold, even if you don't mean it that way.

Agar tu genuinely chill chahta hai, toh thoda natural rakh. Kuch like:

"Bhai badhai! Batana toh tha pehle, par koi baat nahi. Main flatmate dhoondhna shuru karta hoon next week se."

Isme tera hurt bhi dikh raha hai — but respectfully, without being aggressive. Aur usko bhi chance milega ki woh apni taraf se kuch bole. Agar woh genuinely dost hai, toh woh ispe respond karega.

Warna jo tu likh raha hai na, woh closure dikh raha hai — jaise tu baat hi khatam kar raha ho. Agar yahi chahiye toh fine, par agar dosti rakhni hai aage bhi, toh thoda door khol ke rakh.

Kya soch raha hai — dosti aage bhi rakhni hai ya bas move on?
